\column{0.75\textwidth}
\small
\begin{enumerate}
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{Uprość całkowicie: $\dfrac{18}{24}$}{Fully \ealkey{simplify}: $\dfrac{18}{24}$ \ashow{$\dfrac{3}{4}$}}
  \item \ealpara{Oblicz: $2\dfrac{1}{3} + 1\dfrac{1}{2}$}{Calculate: $2\dfrac{1}{3} + 1\dfrac{1}{2}$ \ashow{$=3\dfrac{5}{6}$}}
\end{multicols}
  \item \ealpara{Korzystając z \ealkeytr{modeli słupkowych} po lewej:
  \[
    \tfrac{1}{2} \text{ \ealkeytr{z} } 20 = \ablank{10} \qquad \tfrac{1}{4} \text{ \ealkeytr{z} } 20 = \ablank{5} \qquad \tfrac{3}{4} \text{ \ealkeytr{z} } 20 = \ablank{15}
  \]}
  {Using the \ealkey{bar models} to the left:
  \[
    \tfrac{1}{2} \text{ \ealkey{of} } 20 = \ablank{10} \qquad \tfrac{1}{4} \text{ \ealkey{of} } 20 = \ablank{5} \qquad \tfrac{3}{4} \text{ \ealkey{of} } 20 = \ablank{15}
  \]}
  \item \ealpara{Oblicz:
  \[
    \tfrac{1}{3} \text{ \ealkeytr{z} } 24 \qquad \tfrac{2}{3} \text{ \ealkeytr{z} } 24
  \]}
  {Calculate:
  \[
    \tfrac{1}{3} \text{ \ealkey{of} } 24 \qquad \tfrac{2}{3} \text{ \ealkey{of} } 24
  \] \ashow{$8$ and $16$}}
  \item \ealpara{Uzupełnij puste miejsce: $\quad \dfrac{3}{4}$ \ealkeytr{z} $\ablank{24} = 18$}{Fill in the blank: $\quad \dfrac{3}{4}$ \ealkey{of} $\ablank{24} = 18$}
  \item \ealpara{Prawda czy fałsz? „$\dfrac{1}{2}$ \ealkeytr{z} $30 = 30 \div 2$.” Wyjaśnij swoje rozumowanie.}{True or false? ``$\dfrac{1}{2}$ \ealkey{of} $30 = 30 \div 2$.'' Explain your reasoning. \ashow{True. $\tfrac12$ \ealkey{of} $30 = 15$ and $30 \div 2 = 15$.}}
\begin{multicols}{2}
  \item \ealpara{Znajdź $\dfrac{2}{5}$ \ealkeytr{z} $35$.}{Find $\dfrac{2}{5}$ \ealkey{of} $35$. \ashow{$14$}}
  \vspace{2em}
  \item \ealpara{Wstążka o długości $60\,\text{cm}$ została pocięta. Amy bierze $\dfrac{3}{4}$ \ealkeytr{z} niej. Jak długa jest jej część?}{A $60\,\text{cm}$ ribbon is cut. Amy takes $\dfrac{3}{4}$ \ealkey{of} it. How long is her piece? \ashow{$45$ cm}}
\end{multicols}

\small
\begin{enumerate}
\begin{multicols}{3}
  \item \ealpara{Uprość: $\dfrac{20}{30}$}{Simplify: $\dfrac{20}{30}$ \ashow{$\dfrac{2}{3}$}}
  \item \ealpara{Uprość: $\dfrac{84}{108}$}{Simplify: $\dfrac{84}{108}$ \ashow{$\dfrac{7}{9}$}}
\end{multicols}

  \item \ealpara{Zamień $4\dfrac{3}{5}$ na \ealkeytr{ułamek niewłaściwy}.}{Convert $4\dfrac{3}{5}$ to an \ealkey{improper fraction}. \ashow{$\dfrac{23}{5}$}}

  \item \ealpara{Oblicz: $2\dfrac{3}{4} + 1\dfrac{3}{5}$}{Calculate: $2\dfrac{3}{4} + 1\dfrac{3}{5}$ \ashow{$=4\dfrac{7}{20}$}}

  \item \ealpara{$\dfrac{3}{4}$ \ealkeytr{z} liczby wynosi $27$. Korzystając z \ealkeytr{modelu słupkowego}, znajdź całą liczbę.}{$\dfrac{3}{4}$ \ealkey{of} a number is $27$. Use the \ealkey{bar model} to find the whole number. \ashow{$36$}}

  \item \ealpara{Jack wydaje $\dfrac{1}{3}$ \ealkeytr{z} kieszonkowego w poniedziałek i $\dfrac{1}{4}$ we wtorek. Jaki \ealkeytr{ułamek} pozostaje?}{Jack spends $\dfrac{1}{3}$ \ealkey{of} his pocket money on Monday and $\dfrac{1}{4}$ on Tuesday. What \ealkey{fraction} remains? \ashow{$\dfrac{5}{12}$}}

  \item \ealpara{Dzbanek mieści $1\dfrac{1}{2}$ litra. Napełniasz $\dfrac{2}{3}$ \ealkeytr{z} niego. Ile to mililitrów?}{A jug holds $1\dfrac{1}{2}$ litres. You fill $\dfrac{2}{3}$ \ealkey{of} it. How many millilitres is that? \ashow{$1000$ mL}}

  \item \ealpara{Pokaż, że $\dfrac{2}{3} \times \dfrac{3}{4} = \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{2}{3}$, korzystając z diagramów pól.}{Show that $\dfrac{2}{3} \times \dfrac{3}{4} = \dfrac{3}{4} \times \dfrac{2}{3}$ using area diagrams.}

\end{enumerate}
